summary.fixed_offset_selection: Median of equally spaced locally matched spectral-window timing offsets; minimizes sum of absolute timing errors over qualified windows. Not a phase-coherent waveform match.
notes: Initial strict 19-window waveform analysis found no reliable constant-offset correspondence.
Stretch search identifies a drifting shared song pattern, followed by an edit/structure difference in the final section.
The constant offset is an approximate compromise; it does not correct tempo or edit differences.
Weak windows are excluded rather than assigned invented timings.
